description: Free. Returns any message sent to an address on Base alongside a token transfer. Two channels: a MemoSender `Memo` event, which you can also subscribe to yourself, and older memos appended to ERC-20 transfer calldata, which the Transfer event does not carry and transfer indexers do not return. If you received a token and want to know why, call this with your address. No key, wallet or payment.

limit.description: How many recent transfers to inspect (default 10, max 50).

name: read_messages
title: Read messages sent to your address
